english.title: Use / cause to be used motor vehicle in Blackwell / Silvertown Tunnels carrying insecure load / load not contained
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[caused to be used]_

in the

(C)_[Blackwall]_
(D)_[Silvertown]_

tunnel, a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..) which carried a load that was not contained or secured at all times, and in such a position that neither a danger or nuisance was caused or likely to be caused to a person or property by reason of the load or any part of it or being thrown from the motor vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 7(10) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
